first_focused.limitation: The positive case failed in its test snapshot before authority preparation. Deepcopy cannot copy the immutable mappings inside Core values. No permission result was established.

observations: Matching grant produces actual SATISFIED assessments and AUTHORIZE.
Wrong grantee produces actual VIOLATED assessments and BLOCK.
Controlled engine failure produces MonitorFailure, UnavailableAuthorityAssessment/UNKNOWN and CLARIFY.
Every permission checkpoint and JSONL-only reopen preserve the complete accepted domain frame and B/Y/1.
Policy decision and replay do not invoke a check producer.
Invalid preparation and absent proposal ACCEPT refuse before retention.
Substitute owners refuse without being consulted.
Permission introduces no dispatch, execution or observation.
test_snapshot_guard: Snapshots use public canonical KCS/revision bytes, detached graph bytes and frozen history entries. A real-prefix regression checks those representations; a structural regression rejects deepcopy in the module. No production Core change was made.
remaining_verification: Expanded authority stale-computation and late atomic-refusal boundaries.
Relevant unified authorization gate and its independent retained replay evidence.
broader_gate: The earlier population selection has 512 passes and one Core-confirmed historical document-example failure. This result neither fixes nor waives it. The separate 141-pass action-entry gate excludes this authorization module; counts are not added.
